study: Bellecourt et al. (2019), Journal of Molecular Biology 431, 696–713
locator: Figure 5A and accompanying Results, with the time course in Figure S5
preparation: In vitro bacterial transcription at the hisL terminator. RNA was labelled before the chase.
observable: Released terminator-length RNA as a fraction of all terminator-length RNA at sampling. A separate signal measured departure of polymerase.
role: Descriptive evidence that transcript release can be recorded separately from RNA synthesis. Individual detachment times and later survival of the same released molecules were not measured.
